title: The units comparison restricts to an isomorphism on the isomorphism locus
statement:
Let $
u:Y	o C$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and let $V\subseteq C$ be open such that $
u^{-1}(V)	o V$ is an isomorphism. Write $j:V	o C$ for inclusion. The canonical units comparison $\mathbf G_{m,C}	o
u_*\mathbf G_{m,Y}$ [def-sc-gm-torsor], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], which on an etale C-scheme T pulls back units along $T	imes_C Y	o T$, becomes an isomorphism after applying $j^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. No dimension, reducedness or base field hypothesis is required.

source.place: Proof, Step 2 (normalization), units sequence and its cokernel; proof text retained in the parent DAG node

proof.text: Use upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction for the open immersion j to compute inverse image by restriction along composition of etale objects with j. On an etale V-scheme T the restricted units comparison is therefore induced by the projection T times_C Y to T.

Let sq be the pullback square defining the restriction of ν to V. Lift the maps T times_C Y to V and Y through sq. Pullback cancellation (IsPullback.of_bot) identifies the projection T times_C Y to T as a base change of ν restricted to V, hence an isomorphism. Global sections and units preserve it. Objectwise isomorphisms give an isomorphism of presheaves, then of sheaves. Naturality of upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction transports this to the inverse image map. Empty T and V are included.
